title: E0 agent output -- e0-open-look (per question) OR e0-category-grouper (per tag)
description: E0 is the one E step with TWO agents of different shapes behind a single schema file, because config/steps.yaml has one output_schema per step. Spec 13/E0's procedure: (1) e0-open-look answers in free words with NO categories shown; (2) e0-category-grouper groups those free answers per tag and marks keep/new/merge/drop against the starting list; (3) a SCRIPT exports codebook/E0_findings/category_sheet.csv (scripts/e0_category_sheet.py). The two agent branches below have disjoint required-key sets, so `oneOf` always resolves unambiguously and scripts/checks/E0.py can tell which worker produced a file from its keys alone. WHAT E0 MUST NEVER DO: write or change codebook/E*.md, or change config/allowed_values.yaml -- spec 13/E0 'Never: write codebook/E*.md. Those are the owner's.' E0 only gives the owner data. scripts/e0_category_sheet.py refuses by construction to write any path other than its one CSV, and tests/test_e_checks.py asserts that refusal. BRANCH 1 (e0-open-look) IS FREE TEXT ON PURPOSE: it must contain no category names at all ('Never mention or invent category names'), because a tagger that has been shown the list stops discovering and starts matching. That cannot be said in a schema, so scripts/checks/E0.py scans the free text for every value in config/allowed_values.yaml and fails on a leak. SAMPLE SIZE: spec 13/E0 asks for ~300 questions, ~100 per subject, across many chapters. The bank holds 10 canonical questions today, from one paper (2023 MAIN) and one subject-mix, so E0 cannot meaningfully run yet -- stated here, not discovered later.

oneOf.title: e0-open-look (step E0.1, one question, free words, no categories shown)

student_must.description: Completes 'To get this right, the student must ___' in plain words describing the ACTION. Must not name a category (no 'elimination', no 'recall') -- scripts/checks/E0.py enforces it against the real value lists.

built_as.description: How the question is built, in a few plain words. The free-text precursor of E1; must not name an E1 value.

asks_to_pick.description: What it asks the student to pick. The free-text precursor of E2; must not name an E2 value.

ncert_material.description: What NCERT material it uses. The free-text precursor of E3; must not name an E3 value.

wrong_options.description: One phrase per WRONG option, keyed by option number. The free-text precursor of E5, and the same per-wrong-option granularity: the correct answer's own number must NOT appear as a key (scripts/checks/E0.py checks it against the answer the runner supplied). Normally 3 keys; fewer for a multiple_accepted question.

oneOf.title: e0-category-grouper (step E0.2, one tag, groups the free answers)

tag.description: The five tags spec 13/E0 names for grouping. E6's descriptive fields are script-derived and are not discovered this way.

definition.description: One line. For a keep/merge/drop decision this is the starting list's own text copied EXACTLY (Universal rule 6); for a `new` category it is the agent's own one-line definition.

decision.description: keep/merge/drop apply to a category that IS on the starting list; `new` only to one that is not. scripts/checks/E0.py enforces that both ways against the starting_list the runner supplied -- a `new` name that is really already an allowed value would otherwise read to the owner as a discovery.

subjects.description: config/allowed_values.yaml subject. Must agree with which counts are non-zero (checked).

examples.description: Spec 13/E0 asks for 2 example question ids. maxItems is 2 and there is no minItems, because a starting-list category legitimately kept with count 0 ('keep with count 0 if rare by nature; say why') has no examples to give. scripts/checks/E0.py requires the example count to be consistent with the total count, and every example to be a question id that was actually in this tag's answers.

unclear.description: Question ids whose free answer fitted no group. Every answer goes into exactly one group OR here -- scripts/checks/E0.py reconciles the totals against the answers the runner supplied, so a silently dropped answer cannot pass.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
